summary: Engineer bridging mechanical design, automation, software, and experimental engineering to solve complex industrial problems.

bullet_points.text: Designed, developed, and manufactured custom industrial solutions spanning mechanical engineering, control, and automation, from concept through prototyping and validation, including fully integrated industrial automation systems such as an IP69K-rated dynamic checkweigher for the food-processing industry.
Manufactured a custom rocket motor, combining mechanical design and precision machining.

link.display: SolarShape: Solar Concentrator for Industrial Processing PRR-funded project

children.text: Led the development of a solar concentration system for direct industrial heat production, coordinating the integration of mechanical, optical, electrical, and control systems from architecture through prototype validation.

Engineered the core machine control system in CODESYS (IEC 61131-3 Structured Text) using EtherCAT for real-time motion control. Developed a Go-based computer vision service and web UI, linked to the PLC via OPC UA.
Designed the electrical and control architecture and produced electrical schematics using SkyCAD.
Developed a solar-powered 3D printer proof of concept, coupling concentrated solar energy to the printhead through an optical fiber.

bullet_points.text: Conducted mechanical testing under ballistic impact loading to evaluate material performance and dynamic response.
Performed mechanical characterization under high strain-rate conditions using the Split-Hopkinson bar technique, including analysis of stress-strain response.
Developed and operated high-speed data acquisition systems using NI-DAQ and LabVIEW, capturing signals from strain gauges and custom-developed capacitive displacement sensors.
Conducted experimental testing under cryogenic and high-temperature conditions, including sensor installation, instrumentation setup, and configuration for extreme environments.
Supervised students during experimental procedures and the development of Master's theses.

education.institution: Instituto Superior Técnico — University of Lisbon
education.notes: Doctoral research completed, degree not awarded. Programme currently on hold at my request.
education.dissertation_title: Development of an advanced concentrated solar collector for direct use of solar energy in industrial processes, demonstrating the possibility of attaining a quasi-homogeneous radiation flux.

bullet_points.text: Designed and developed a real-time two-axis solar tracker combining predictive Sun-position algorithms with computer-vision feedback using OpenCV.
Developed and experimentally validated the tracking and motion-control system for a solar concentrator.

Designed and developed the mechanical and optical components of the solar concentrator, including machining multiple paraboloid mirrors and experimentally validating different reflector configurations.
Built and experimentally validated a 200 W demonstration prototype for solar-thermal applications.
Presented research results at international conferences including SPIE Optics + Photonics 2024 (San Diego, USA) and EMRS Fall Meeting 2018 (Warsaw, Poland), with publications in the field.
